event.title: I Love Free Software Day 2026 – Pula Get-Together! in Pula, Croatia

body.p: 🎉 I Love Free Software Day 2026 – Pula Get-Together! 🎉

ul.li: 📍 Where: Snack Bar Cabahia, Širolina ul. 4, 52100, Pula, Croatia

🎉 We’re keeping it simple and fun! Join us at Snack Bar Cabahia to celebrate "I Love Free Software Day" with good vibes, great company, and a big THANK YOU to all the amazing people who make Free Software possible. The meeting will be just a relaxed get-together to chat, share stories, and enjoy some drinks and snacks. Whether you’re a developer, user, or just curious about Free Software, you’re welcome! You find more information here

Why come?
Meet fellow Free Software lovers in Istria.
Raise a glass to the maintainers and contributors who keep our software free and open.
Hang out, share ideas, and celebrate the freedom to use, study, share, and improve software.
💬 Spread the word: Invite friends, colleagues, or anyone who loves software freedom. No registration needed. Just show up!
